tickets.title: Statistical procedure execution and the 15.4 option contract
tickets.source: S154 / Chapter 3 / `Introduction` (PDF pp. 27–36); S154 / Chapter 2 / `What's New in SAS/STAT 15.4` (PDF pp. 25–26); S154 / Chapter 1 / `Procedures by Category` (PDF pp. 13–24).
tickets.scope: Establish PROC-level parsing, default-parameter, execution-status, and result-object contracts; distinguish valid input, invalid input, and unsupported capabilities under SAS/STAT 15.4. This ticket owns shared interfaces; PROC tickets own their semantics.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Provide minimal execution contract tests; define option defaults, explicit overrides, and procedure-specific RUN/QUIT rules; emit locatable diagnostics for unimplemented branches; record the specification version and handle version differences explicitly.

cases.covers: Runtime version, PROC dispatch, RUN/QUIT and default result objects

tickets.title: Statistical data selection, missing values, and observation weight interfaces
tickets.source: S154 / Chapter 13 / `Introduction to Scoring, Standardization, and Ranking Procedures` (PDF pp. 253–254); S154 / Chapter 22 / `FREQ Statement` (PDF p. 564); S154 / Chapter 22 / `ID Statement` (PDF p. 564); S154 / Chapter 22 / `VAR Statement` (PDF p. 570); S154 / Chapter 22 / `WEIGHT Statement` (PDF p. 570).
source_headings: Introduction to Scoring, Standardization, and Ranking Procedures
tickets.scope: Provide shared data access interfaces for BY, variable roles, FREQ, WEIGHT, ID, and missing-value filtering; individual procedures determine exclusion granularity, weight meaning, and invalid-value behavior rather than imposing one global policy.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Use multiple groups to verify traceability of original row numbers, variable types, and missing indicators; keep frequency and analysis weights separate in the interface; PROC-specific filtering policies must not modify the original data.

cases.covers: BY selection and the distinct frequency/analysis weight roles

tickets.title: Rank-deficient linear algebra and generalized inverses
tickets.source: S154 / Chapter 4 / `Important Linear Algebra Concepts` (PDF pp. 58–65).
tickets.scope: Provide interfaces for linear equations, rank determination, projections, and generalized inverses; expose singular and nearly singular states under a consistent precision policy.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: For full-rank, exactly rank-deficient, and nearly collinear matrices, verify decomposition reconstruction, projection identities, and generalized-inverse identities against independent analytic results; explain scale-dependent tolerances and do not return success for numerical failure.

cases.covers: Exact linear dependence, generalized inverse solution and singularity diagnostics

tickets.title: Linear model moments and covariance foundations
tickets.source: S154 / Chapter 4 / `Expectations of Random Variables and Vectors` (PDF pp. 65–68); S154 / Chapter 4 / `Mean Squared Error` (PDF pp. 68–69); S154 / Chapter 4 / `Linear Model Theory` (PDF pp. 69–80); S154 / Chapter 7 / `Introduction to Mixed Modeling Procedures` (PDF pp. 135–148).
source_headings: Expectations of Random Variables and Vectors
tickets.scope: Implement shared linear model moments, residual sums of squares, variance, and covariance calculations; preserve the distinction between frequency and analysis weights.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Use manually calculable intercept-only, weighted, and rank-deficient models to verify coefficients, residuals, degrees of freedom, and covariance; verify scaling relationships.

cases.covers: Weighted normal equations, residual variance and coefficient covariance

tickets.title: Shared interfaces for tests, tail probabilities, and confidence intervals
tickets.source: S154 / Chapter 4 / `Hypothesis Testing and Power` (PDF p. 58); S154 / Chapter 5 / `Testing Linear Hypotheses` (PDF p. 112); S154 / Chapter 5 / `Parameter Estimates and Associated Statistics` (PDF pp. 106–110).
tickets.scope: Establish shared result conventions for statistics, degrees of freedom, one-/two-sided tail probabilities, and intervals; callers specify distributions and correction formulas from the relevant guide sections.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Use independent reference values for positive/negative statistics, one-/two-sided conversions, degenerate degrees of freedom, and extreme tails; each caller records absolute/relative tolerances and justification rather than masking tail errors with a broad common tolerance.

cases.covers: Two-sided and directed one-sided probabilities and intervals
